So, instead of relying heavily on frame-by-frame drawing, it focuses on vector animation and key frame interpolation. So, you can create characters or objects once, rig them with bones and controls, and then animate their movements using key frames. The software automatically generates the in-between frames, which can save a huge amount of time. This makes Synfig particularly useful for motion graphics, cutout animation, and projects where you want to reuse assets across many scenes. It is a powerful system once you get used to the workflow, and it can produce very smooth animations without needing thousands of hand-drawn frames.
